page.content:
Noctua was sent by Zantara to guide the Prisoner after they arrived on Arrakis. They were arrested by the Sardaukar when they were spotted with her in Harko Village.

page.overview:
Who is Noctua?

Noctua was sent by Zantara to guide the Prisoner after they arrived on Arrakis. They were arrested by the Sardaukar when they were spotted with her in Harko Village.
